title: Account Assistant - Temp
description:
Finance Reconciliation Officer

Temporary Contract Finance Department

Reporting to: Bursar
Department: Finance
Contract Type: Temporary

The Opportunity

We are seeking a highly organised and detail-oriented Finance Reconciliation Officer to support the Finance Department in an Independent School on a temporary basis. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced finance professional with strong Sage Accounting and advanced Excel skills who can confidently reconcile supplier and customer accounts, investigate discrepancies, and provide accurate financial reporting.

The successful candidate will play a key role in ensuring financial records are accurate, fully supported, and presented clearly to the Bursar.

Key Responsibilities
- Reconcile supplier and customer accounts, ensuring balances are accurate and up to date.
- Review and investigate historical discrepancies, missing transactions, and outstanding balances.
- Collect and organise supporting documentation, including invoices, statements, payments, and credit notes.
- Identify and resolve aged balances, duplicate transactions, and unapplied payments.
- Use Sage Accounting to review transactions, analyse account balances, and extract reports.
- Prepare detailed reconciliation schedules and reports using Excel.
- Maintain accurate and organised audit trails for all reconciliations.
- Present findings and recommendations clearly to the Bursar.
- Escalate significant issues with proposed solutions where appropriate.

Essential Skills & Experience
- Strong practical experience using Sage Accounting Software.
- Advanced Excel skills, including:
- Pivot Tables
- VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP
- SUMIFS
- Data analysis and reporting
- Proven experience reconciling supplier and customer accounts.
- Strong understanding of:
- Purchase Ledger
- Sales Ledger
- Payments
- Credit Notes
- Account Balances
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Ability to work independently and manage competing priorities.
- Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain financial information clearly.

Key Deliverables
- Fully reconciled supplier and customer account balances.
- Complete supporting documentation for all reconciliations.
- Clear records of discrepancies identified and actions taken.
- Summary reconciliation reports for the Bursar.
- Accurate financial records supported by a robust audit trail.

Apply Now

If you have strong Sage and Excel skills, excellent reconciliation experience, and enjoy resolving complex accounting discrepancies, we would like to hear from you.

Contact Muzna Naqvi at Reed Reading Office for more details

title: Accounts Payable & Account Receivable Specialiist
description:
Morson are recruiting on behalf of an Aerospace company based in Reading that designs and develops the next-generation sixth-generation combat aircraft for the Global Combat Air Programme (GCAP).

The Accounts Payable & Accounts Receivable Specialist will join the team at a critical time in the GCAP programme, the standing up and fast growth of the Joint Venture. This is a rare opportunity to have a long-term impact on the success of the JV, by playing a crucial role in the initial stages of the life of the new organisation and laying the foundations for its success through carrying out the sound transactional financial services and inputting into the design of the function.

This position is critical for the company and will be a member of the team responsible for the operation of the Accounts Payable (AP) and Accounts Receivable (AR) function ensuring the accuracy of the company's accounts and maintaining the company's assets and liabilities.

You will contribute to the smooth operation of accounting processes through daily management of incoming and outgoing invoices, proposing and running payment runs, performing reconciliation of the subledgers and supplier statements, and collaboration with relevant stakeholders through monthly Aged Creditor/Debtor reviews and GRNI reviews.
This role will report into the Accounts Payable & Accounts Receivable Manager.

Key Accountabilities;
Accounts Payable Related Duties;
- Accurately and timely posting of payable invoices entries relating to Accounts Payable, accrued expenses, and prepaid expenses.
- Reconcile AP Subledger balances with invoices received from supplier.
- Verify appropriateness of payments through reconciling invoices, Good Receipts, and Purchase Orders (3-way matching) and managing and resolving GRNI exceptions through Aged GRNI Reviews.
- Prepare payment schedules aligned with due dates and create bank transfer data working together with Treasury team.
- Review and process Non PO and Ad-hoc payments
- Managed aged and blocked invoices through organising and chairing of Aged Creditor Reviews.

Accounts Receivable Related Duties;
- Confirm incoming money in bank accounts and perform Cash allocations (application/matching) against billing data
- Identify overdue receivables and collaborate with Sales team to promote collection
- Conduct AR balance confirmation procedures with customers, especially at period-end

Other General Duties;
- Support month-end and year-end closing processes, including verifying AP/AR account balances, conducting account analysis, and preparing audit documentation
- Propose and implement improvements to accounting processes through digitalisation, automation, and governance and internal control enhancements
- Supplier and customer query handling and management, ensuring a positive relationship with all stakeholders and supporting the Treasury team with cashflow forecasting

Qualifications;
- The jobholder will possess strong curiosity about figures
- Excellent accuracy and attention to detail and the ability to meet deadlines
- Strong communication skills with the ability to liaise confidently with internal and external stakeholders
- Flexible to changes and proactive in pursuing business process improvements
- Practical experience in either AP, AR, or both and
basic bookkeeping knowledge
- PC proficiency in Excel
- Experience using ERP system such as SAP would be an advantage
- Have an ability to collaborate with stakeholders and colleagues of various backgrounds, relaying financial concepts in a simple and understandable manner
- Language proficiency in Japanese or Italian would be an advantage.

This is an excellent opportunity to join the business at an exciting time.

Morson is acting as an Employment Business in relation to this vacancy.

Accounts assistant; accounts payable, accounts receivable; purchase ledger; sales ledger; SAP; SAGE; AAT; payroll; VAT returns; reconciliation; credit control; Japanese; Italian

title: Finance Administrator
description:
Finance Administrator - Maidenhead - £24,000 / £26,000

About the Client

Wade Macdonald are currently working with a well-established organisation with a presence across London. With a collaborative working environment and a centralised finance function, they value strong relationships, accuracy and excellent service.

About the Job

An excellent opportunity has arisen for a Finance Administrator to join a busy finance department based in central Maidenhead. Working alongside an experienced team, you will support a range of day to day financial and administrative activities whilst receiving comprehensive in-house training. This is an ideal opportunity for someone looking to develop their skills and build a long-term career in finance within a supportive and collaborative environment.

Duties will include:
- Recording incoming payments and making sure they are added to the correct accounts.
- Processing payments to customers and suppliers in the UK and overseas.
- Making sure charges and expenses are recorded against the correct client accounts.
- Helping to check bank statements and ensuring financial records are accurate.
- Processing invoices and keeping financial transactions up to date.
- Using Excel to help prepare financial reports and keep records organised.
- Preparing daily reports and checking that transactions have been recorded correctly.
- Carrying out day-to-day tasks using online banking systems.

About the Successful Applicant

The ideal candidate will have 3-5 GCSEs at grades 9-4 (A -C), including Maths and English, alongside a good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Word and Outlook. Strong numerical accuracy, attention to detail and confident communication skills are essential. You will be organised, enthusiastic about developing a career in finance and comfortable working both independently and as part of a team.

What You Will Receive in Return

This is a fantastic opportunity to take your first steps into an accounting career with an established and supportive organisation. You will benefit from full in-house training, guidance from experienced finance colleagues and practical exposure to a broad range of accounting responsibilities. With a collaborative team environment and the opportunity to build valuable professional skills, this position provides a strong foundation for your future career in finance.

title: Part-Time Finance Administrator
description:
Part-Time Finance Administrator - Flexible Hours

Are you an experienced finance professional looking for a part-time role that offers flexibility, a friendly working environment and a good work-life balance? We're working with an established engineering business looking for a reliable, hands-on Part-Time Finance Administrator to join their small, friendly team. This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys getting involved in the day-to-day finances of a business, likes a bit of banter and wants to work in a relaxed but professional environment.

The Role

Preparing and updating weekly cash flow forecasts.

Managing month-end financial processes.

Preparing the year-end trial balance for the external accountant.

Preparing and submitting VAT returns.

Maintaining accurate financial records using Sage.

Providing general finance and accounts support.

No payroll or sales invoicing responsibilities - the focus is on core finance and keeping the numbers in good shape.

What We're Looking For

Previous experience in a finance or accounts role.

Good working knowledge of Sage 50

Experience with VAT returns, month-end and year-end processes.

Confidence preparing cash flow forecasts.

Someone organised, reliable and comfortable working independently.

A friendly, down-to-earth personality who enjoys working as part of a small team.

You'll be joining a small engineering business where everyone works closely together. The environment is practical, friendly and informal, with plenty of good banter along the way!

They're looking for someone who will fit into the team, get on with the job and bring a positive, professional attitude.

Approximately 3-4 days per week.

Around 5 hours per day, ideally 15-20 hours per week.

Flexibility to discuss a working pattern that works for both you and the business.

Salary dependent on experience

title: Payroll Officer - Local Authority
description:
Payroll Officer

Local Authority in Berkshire
Competitive Hourly Rate
Hybrid Working

Reed Public Sector is delighted to be partnering with a Local Authority in Berkshire to recruit an experienced Payroll Officer on an initial 3-month contract. This is an excellent opportunity for a payroll professional with local government experience to join a busy and supportive HR and Payroll team.

The Role

- Process payroll transactions accurately and within agreed deadlines.
- Support monthly payroll processing, payroll reconciliation, and reporting requirements.
- Administer Local Government Pension Scheme (LGPS) and Teachers' Pension submissions.
- Maintain accurate payroll records and audit trails in line with internal controls.
- Ensure compliance with payroll legislation, policies, procedures, and data protection requirements.
- Work collaboratively with HR, Finance, managers, and external partners to resolve payroll-related matters.
- Assist with payroll process improvements and service enhancements.
- Deliver a high-quality customer-focused service across telephone, email, face-to-face, and written communications.

About You

Essential
- Experience using the iTrent HR and Payroll System.
- Strong payroll administration experience within a complex organisation.
- Knowledge of Local Government terms and conditions of employment.
- Knowledge of Teachers' terms and conditions of employment.
- Understanding of Local Government Pension Scheme (LGPS) regulations.
- Understanding of Teachers' Pension Scheme regulations.
- GCSE Maths and English (or equivalent experience).
- Excellent attention to detail and ability to process payroll information accurately.
- Strong communication and customer service skills.

Have the expertise and experience?
